comments.author: @jimo1268
comments.text:
I never in my life had any wish to go to India, however recently I had no choice but to go to Mumbai for business and the experience was amazing, a little smelly but it was not a filthy city and the people including the ones living on the street were very friendly. I walked everywhere day and night and not once did I feel I was in danger.

I ate every night at the same restaurant "Gaylords" which has been open for generations and it was the most amazing food, service and had an incredible art deco interior.

Stayed at the Oberoi Mumbai which was as good as any top hotel I have stayed in anywhere around the world.

The architecture of Mumbai is next level and I can't wait to return.

Its always good to look beyond these videos and seek to experience these places for yourself and then make judgement.
